Immediate restatement of أسوة حسنة; adds the hope-oriented addressee and turning-away boundary.
Directly clarifies the exception concerning إبراهيم's promise to his father and subsequent تبرأ.
Extends the surah's exclusive Allah-facing commitments through a formal pledge.
Names العداوة والبغضاء with a distinct causal setting; strong f02 route.

Supports the منيب element of the closing prayer, but is otherwise narrow.
Appearance-before-God link is general and only weakly connected.

Defines Ibrahim through حنيف and مسلم rather than competing group identities.

Pairs surrender to Allah with following ملة إبراهيم حنيفًا.

Continues the Ibrahimic confrontation with his قوم around Allah and associated rivals.
Joins guided orientation with ملة إبراهيم حنيفًا and rejection of شرك.

Adds Ibrahim's request for forgiveness, relevant beside 60:4's explicit exception.
Combines faith in Ibrahim with migration directed to the Lord.
Extends the Ibrahimic rejection of fabricated gods in favor of Allah.

A broader non-alliance formulation that supplies a related communal boundary.
